title: Measuring Machine Learning Harms from Stereotypes Requires Understanding Who Is Harmed by Which Errors in What Ways

bias_targets.methodology: Eliciting human annotations on object-gender stereotypes in image datasets (COCO, OpenImages), and conducting randomized survey experiments to measure pragmatic (beliefs, attitudes, behaviors) and experiential (self-reported negative affect) harms after exposing participants to stereotype-reinforcing, stereotype-violating, and neutral false positive image search errors.
